meta.title: Financial transparency
meta.description: See Friends of Animals’ published income, spending, donation totals and disclosed supporters, from our reconciled ledger.

transparency.title: Where the money goes
transparency.lead: See what Friends of Animals received and spent, straight from our ledger. Finance publishes a month only once it has been reconciled and locked.
transparency.empty: No months have been published yet. Figures will appear here once the first month is reconciled and locked.
transparency.through: Published through {month}. The financial year runs from April to March in India. Months still open are not included.

organisations.title: Organisations that chose disclosure
organisations.lead: Totals for the published months of this financial year, net of refunds. We count only gifts whose organisation chose to be named.
organisations.caption: Disclosed organisation donations
organisations.name: Organisation
organisations.empty: No organisations have been named for these published months.

wall.title: Donor wall
wall.lead: With thanks to people who asked to be named. We never show an individual's donation amount or contact details.
wall.empty: No individual supporters have opted in for these published months.

transparency.method: These figures show actual income and spending, not budgets. Refunds and reversals reduce totals in the month they are posted. If a month needs to be reopened for correction, it is not shown until it is locked again.
